source_caption:
📺 Pitch (2016–2017)

Pitch follows Ginny Baker, a talented young pitcher who makes history by becoming the first woman to play in Major League Baseball when she joins the San Diego Padres. Facing enormous pressure from the media, skeptical teammates, and millions of fans, Ginny must prove that she belongs in a sport traditionally dominated by men. With guidance from veteran catcher Mike Lawson and support from those who believe in her, she navigates intense competition, complicated relationships, personal struggles, and the challenges of sudden fame. Combining emotional storytelling, realistic baseball action, and inspiring moments, the series explores determination, equality, ambition, teamwork, and the courage to break barriers.

🎭 Genre: Sports • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 7.5/10

⏱️ Runtime: ~43 minutes per episode • 1 season • 10 episodes

🎥 Creators: Dan Fogelman and Rick Singer

🏆 Recognition: Starring Kylie Bunbury, Mark-Paul Gosselaar, and Ali Larter, the series received positive reviews for its performances, emotional storytelling, and groundbreaking premise. Major League Baseball cooperated with the production to help create authentic baseball scenes.

📺 Where to Watch: Check Hulu, Amazon Prime Video, and Apple TV for current streaming or digital purchase availability. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Pitch is an American drama television series created by Dan Fogelman and Rick Singer, that aired on Fox from September 22 to December 8, 2016. The series was commissioned on May 10, 2016. On May 1, 2017, Fox canceled the series after one season.
